comment.body:
Thanks for the left-Win/left-Alt reproduction and for attaching the 0.98.0 diagnostic report and screenshot. Please do not upload those again. Could you confirm:
1. Whether the same mapping still fails on current stable PowerToys, including the exact version.
2. If it still fails, whether you can reproduce once more on that version and add a comment containing `/bugreport` immediately afterward so the current capture can be compared with the report already attached.
